title: make test fails at base: runstate maintenance test's control fetch starts no auto maintenance on this host
body: internal/runstate's TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo fails at its CONTROL step — a plain `git fetch` in the armed repository starts no automatic maintenance, 'this fixture proves nothing'. Reproduced at base 444e96be with sj2's changes stashed; it looks host/git-version dependent, but it leaves the store's no-maintenance guarantee unproven wherever it fails.
